The single hard Response(client_arrived, order_taken) clause only requires taking the order after each arrival; nothing in the clause set requires fetching food or serving it, so a client could be ordered and never fed with no clause broken. Add hard Response clauses from client_arrived to the food-fetching/preparation (e.g., holding_food) and to order_served, so every client arrival also demands the food and the serve. The rule-only warning itself is fine here, since every requirement is a 'whenever' consequent and no unconditional goal is stated.

The predicates are consistent with the machine's declared vocabulary and semantics.
